recipe.title: Matcha Latte
recipe.description: This 3-ingredient matcha latte is packed with antioxidants and delicious flavor. A cozy, healthy drink for cool days. Vegan!
ingredients: Maple syrup (honey, stevia, or sweetener of choice, optional)
instructions: Sift your matcha so it is lump-free.
Spoon the matcha into a large mug. Add the hot water and whisk briskly, in an up and down motion, until frothy - about 30 seconds or so. Add the coconut milk and whisk until well combined.
Taste and add additional water, coconut milk, and/or sweetener to your liking.
